' shows only 'Lead bold' with its thread expanded; 'Q?', 'a', ':::note', 'x', ':::' are gone and there is no data-markdown-fallback. Cause: the server's ask takes 'paragraph+ bullet_list?'; drawDirective puts the note's fence paragraphs after the list, ProseMirror refuses that content, and Milkdown drops the whole ask (MilkdownError createNodeInParserFail 'Cannot create node for ask', logged, not thrown). The default engine throws 'unknown typed block "note"' for the same body, so before this change the card fell back to its raw text and no word was lost. Other inputs with the same mechanism: an unknown directive holding a list or a heading inside an ask (':::note' children are spliced into the ask).
